description_en: Retrieves details about the resource groups used for data synchronization
description_zh: 获取数据同步时所用资源组的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-aps-resource-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-bp1t6rym210000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApsResourceGroups

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to view the region ID of a cluster
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看指定集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html operation to view the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html接口查看集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data synchronization task
parameters.name: workload_id

Data.description_en: The information about the resource groups

Available.description_en:
Indicates whether the resource group is available. Valid values:

True

False
Available.description_zh:
资源组是否可用。取值说明：
True：可用。
False：不可用

GroupName.description_en: The name of the resource group

GroupType.description_en:
The type of the resource group. Valid values:

Interactive

Job

For more information about resource groups in Data Lakehouse Edition, see [Resource groups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428610.html）
GroupType.description_zh:
资源组类型，取值：
Interactive
Job
关于湖仓版资源组的详细信息，请参见[资源组介绍]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428610.html）

LeftComputeResource.description_en: The remaining computing resources, in ACU

MaxComputeResource.description_en:
The maximum reserved computing resources, in ACU.

If GroupType is Interactive, the maximum reserved computing resources are the current unallocated resources of the cluster, and the step size is 16 ACU.

If GroupType is Job, the maximum reserved computing resources are the current unallocated resources of the cluster, and the step size is 8 ACU
MaxComputeResource.description_zh:
最大计算预留资源，单位ACU。
当GroupType为Interactive时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为16 ACU。
当GroupType为Job时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为8 ACU

MinComputeResource.description_en:
The minimum reserved computing resources, in ACU.

If GroupType is Interactive, the minimum reserved computing resources are 16 ACU.

If GroupType is Job, the minimum reserved computing resources are 0 ACU
MinComputeResource.description_zh:
最小计算预留资源，单位ACU。
当GroupType为Interactive时，计算预留资源最小为16 ACU。
当GroupType为Job时，计算预留资源最小为0 ACU

Step.description_en:
The step size of the resource group, in ACU.

If GroupType is Interactive, the step size is 16 ACU.

If GroupType is Job, the step size is 8 ACU
Step.description_zh:
资源组的步长，单位ACU。
当GroupType为Interactive时，步长为16 ACU。
当GroupType为Job时，步长为8 ACU

Message.description_en:
Additional information about the call. Valid values:

Success is returned if the request is successful.

An error code is returned if the request fails
Message.description_zh:
调用结果的附加信息。取值说明：
请求正常，返回Success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

True

False
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值说明：
True：成功。
False：失败
